description: This file implements a static class 'StreamDecoder' that provides functionality to decode data streams, specifically handling various predictors such as PNG and TIFF predictors, used in PDF processing context within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: StreamDecoder
classes.description: A static class responsible for decoding compressed data streams, applying predictor algorithms as specified by PDF filters.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes a byte array utilizing parameters specified in a PdfDictionary, handling different predictor algorithms such as PNG and TIFF.
